measurement: journal open cost vs retained journal (D20)
invocation: ORRERY_JOURNAL_DIR=<repo>/target/open-scaling-work ORRERY_OPEN_SCALING_OUT=<out> ORRERY_OPEN_SCALING_STEPS=12 ORRERY_OPEN_SCALING_RECORDS_PER_STEP=50000 cargo test -p orrery_persistd --release --test journal_open_scaling -- --ignored --nocapture
page_cache_note: The journal was written by the same process moments before each reopen and the host has 46 GiB of RAM against a peak 887 MB journal, so every open read from page cache. The measured slope is therefore a floor: a restart after a host failure reads from the device. This is a developer workstation, not the qualified c4d-standard-32-lssd the D19 gate pairs ran on, and the number this file supports is a slope rather than an absolute.
